description: This file serves as a header declaration for the class 'DobbySpecGenerator', which is responsible for generating JSON specifications for container configurations within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It includes method declarations for creating various plugin configurations, mount points, and other runtime specifications based on application configuration and runtime context.

classes.name: DobbySpecGenerator
classes.description: A class responsible for generating container runtime specifications in JSON format, based on application and runtime configurations.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates a JSON specification string based on the provided application and runtime configurations.

methods.name: createEnvVars
methods.description: Creates JSON array of environment variables for the container spec.

methods.name: createMounts
methods.description: Creates JSON array of mount points for the container spec.

methods.name: createRdkPlugins
methods.description: Creates JSON array of RDK plugins for the container spec.

methods.name: createMinidumpPlugin
methods.description: Creates JSON object for the minidump plugin.

methods.name: createAppServiceSDKPlugin
methods.description: Creates JSON object for the App Service SDK plugin.

methods.name: createNetworkPlugin
methods.description: Creates JSON object for network plugins.

methods.name: createBindMount
methods.description: Creates JSON object for a bind mount with source, destination, and options.

methods.name: shouldEnableGpu
methods.description: Determines whether the GPU should be enabled based on the configuration.

methods.name: getSysMemoryLimit
methods.description: Calculates system memory limit from configs.

methods.name: getGPUMemoryLimit
methods.description: Calculates GPU memory limit from configs.

methods.name: getVpuEnabled
methods.description: Checks if VPU is enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: getCpuCores
methods.description: Retrieves the CPU cores allocation as a string.

methods.name: populateClassicPlugins
methods.description: Populates plugin configurations into the JSON spec based on the application configuration.

methods.name: createEthanLogPlugin
methods.description: Creates JSON for Ethan log plugin.

methods.name: createMulticastSocketPlugin
methods.description: Creates JSON for multicast socket plugin.

methods.name: createIonMemoryPlugin
methods.description: Creates JSON for Ion memory plugin.

methods.name: createThunderPlugin
methods.description: Creates JSON for Thunder plugin.

methods.name: createOpenCDMPlugin
methods.description: Creates JSON for OpenCDM plugin.

methods.name: createPrivateDataMount
methods.description: Creates JSON for private data mount point.

methods.name: createFkpsMounts
methods.description: Creates FKPS mounts in the spec.

methods.name: createTmpfsMount
methods.description: Creates a tmpfs mount JSON object.

methods.name: createResourceManagerMount
methods.description: Creates resource manager mount JSON.

methods.name: getWorkingDir
methods.description: Retrieves the working directory configuration.

methods.name: initialiseIonHeapsJson
methods.description: Initializes Ion heaps JSON structure.

methods.name: encodeURL
methods.description: Encodes a URL (possibly percent-encoding).
